figurative_meaning_bn: এই আছে তো এই নাই; ক্ষণস্থায়ী বিষয়
figurative_meaning_en: Something that exists one moment and vanishes the next; a transient or illusory matter
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার সাহায্যের প্রতিশ্রুতি তালপাতার ছায়ার মতোই ছিল।
জীবনের সুখ তালপাতার ছায়ার মতো ক্ষণস্থায়ী।
example_sentences_in_english: His promise of help was like the shadow of a palm leaf.
The joys of life are as transient as the shadow of a palm leaf.
history: This proverb draws from the natural imagery of palm leaves in rural Bengal, symbolizing illusion (মায়া) as the shadow is fleeting and deceptive, often referenced in traditional folklore.
note: The idiom emphasizes the maya (illusion) aspect, common in Bengali proverbial wisdom.
